newsitem.title: JORDAN: PRESS DIGEST - Jordan - Dec 18. [CORRECTED 12:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Jordan - Dec 18. [CORRECTED 12:15 GMT]

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein ignites "flame of peace" and says "will work to keep it ignited".
- Cabinet verifies first group of 107 detainees arrested during civil disturbances last August over rise in bread prices covered by royal pardon.
- $30 million estimated cost of developing tourism in Petra, says tourism official. (Corrects from $300 million)
- Crown prince stresses consolidating inter-Arab ties, says water "is the coming challenge".
- Crown prince says Jordan Valley is important for stability and investment.
- Information minister says responsibility of media "is to allow the participation of citizens in national issues".
- Political activists meeting in Amman seek means to prepare for new world order.
